text.p: These are the leading stories in the Egyptian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Hosni Mubarak holds urgent talks with Palestinian President Yasser Arafat before meeting with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu today.
- The joint Egyptian-Syrian committee agrees to create a free-trade zone and approves joint ventures. Trade exchange to be increased to $200 million.
- Finance Minister Mohieddin el-Gharib tells parliament that the government has paid out 178 million pounds ($52.44 million) to farmers who plant sugar-cane.
- Today, the fate of peace is to be decided. Mubarak-Netanyahu summit meeting in Sharm el-Sheikh is to create a positive atmosphere to resume negotiations.
- The Arab Fund for Economic and Social Development allocates $300 million in soft loans to finance projects in Egypt.
- Mubarak receives Syrian Prime Minister Mahmoud Zu'bi, who says his country seeks economic integration with Egypt.
- The health ministry receives the first batch of mobile clinics equipped by the Aircraft Factory of the Arab Organisation for Industralisation.
